title: People Don't Buy Your Product. They Buy the Promise.
description: Customers do not buy features alone; they buy the change they believe the product can create. Learn how to translate product value, service, and outcomes into a clear, credible promise.
cta: Next, we turn that promise into an offer that is easy to understand, credible, and easy to buy.
alternativeTitles: People Don't Buy the Product. They Buy the Change.
Stop Explaining Features. Start Selling the Outcome.

shortA.title: What Is the Customer Really Buying?
shortA.alternateHook: Remove the product name. Can you still explain why the outcome matters?

shortB.title: A Promise Is Not a Slogan
shortB.alternateHook: A stronger promise should make real value clearer, not make reality bigger.
